## Review before publication

- [ ] Build and browser QA passed for this PR revision.
- [ ] I inspected desktop/mobile screenshots and the latest independent QA report (NOT REVIEWED is not a pass).
- [ ] Role, ownership and outcome claims have evidence; any remaining uncertainty is explicit.
- [ ] Human owner explicitly approved publication of this revision. No auto-merge.

Current main pushes publish immediately. This checklist records intent; it does not enforce deployment protection.
